functional.title: Invoice and voyage intake
functional.definition: Parse bounded CSV and a canonical JSON form, normalize amounts as integer minor units, require voyage, terminal and invoice identity, and preserve file provenance.

functional.title: Tariff clock and day ledger
functional.definition: Model effective tariff versions, terminal-local dates, rate tiers, exception calendars and explicit start/end inclusion. Make each day independently inspectable.

functional.title: Evidence graph and uncertainty
functional.definition: Attach signed or authenticated source records to events; identify conflicts and bounded gaps and compute alternative valid charge outcomes.

functional.title: Quote and scoped acquisition
functional.definition: Capture quote, price asset, expiry, permitted seller and redistribution rights. Require an applicable case budget, an auditable comparison and a Kite-compatible payment route before dispatch.

functional.title: Partner reconciliation
functional.definition: Implement authenticated retrieval or callbacks with idempotency, provenance hashes, unknown-order handling and selective retry. Add manual conflict resolution and a reason trail.

functional.title: Analyst casebook and export
functional.definition: Build a keyboard-accessible invoice/day comparison and evidence panel. Export review-approved calculations and licensed attachments with a case manifest.

functional.title: Credit posting and portfolio reporting
functional.definition: Record referenced credits against invoice lines and expose disputed, submitted where manually evidenced, and credited amounts across active cases, with per-currency subtotals.

functional.title: End-to-end operator replay
functional.definition: Exercise import, governed data acquisition, late correction, exported artifacts and accounting through normal user surfaces; provide a licensed pilot-fixture intake path.

nonfunctional.title: Replayable evidence
nonfunctional.definition: A reviewer can reproduce the outcome from the exact input revision, actor scope, persisted decision and redacted evidence reference after a process restart.

invariants.title: Invoice and voyage intake
invariants.definition: A duplicate file or invoice identifier cannot create a second charge line silently.

invariants.title: Tariff clock and day ledger
invariants.definition: An invoice calculation always names an immutable tariff version and currency.

invariants.title: Evidence graph and uncertainty
invariants.definition: Potential dispute and confirmed credit are different fields with separate provenance.

invariants.title: Quote and scoped acquisition
invariants.definition: A case limit in INR cannot be compared to token units without a specified valid conversion.

invariants.title: Partner reconciliation
invariants.definition: Correction creates a new source revision; original raw records remain traceable.

invariants.title: Analyst casebook and export
invariants.definition: Any changed tariff, gate record or source revision invalidates the active approval.

invariants.title: Credit posting and portfolio reporting
invariants.definition: A package export cannot increase cash recovered; duplicate carrier credit references do not double-count.

invariants.title: End-to-end operator replay
invariants.definition: A gap or unavailable partner is visible to both analyst and operator after restart.
